family: One R14-derived causal family: action obtains source report; native comparator meets actual independent consequence; spatial normalizer changes mobile policy; symmetric probe obtains P or Q
initial_policy: P, a declared unlearned initial native direction
physical_error: directional comparison, never a Python-computed penalty
preparation: all alternative turn packets, queries and source contents exist before T0; future actual report uses static declared channels
world: explicit finite external report class with native physically prepared P/Q data resources; roles can be swapped between worlds
decoder_frozen: current records at write10/action11/information14; policy directionsA/B, action0/action1, received report dx with dy1dz0; absent/ambiguous retained
source_information_scope: binary finite report agreement with actual class, not learned arbitrary utility or an optimal information policy
reuse_limit: one policy revision and later source use; consumed finite resources, no repeated revision promised
